annotations.title: Split versions into their own assets

description: Move each version in version_ids out of its asset into a new asset of its own, in the same folder, named after the version, with the same sharing. An asset always keeps at least one version; a version that is already alone is reported already_separate. Undo it with versions_add. No media or feedback is ever deleted; feedback stays on its version. contents(asset_id) lists an asset's versions. Results are per version; earlier ones are not undone if a later one fails.
name: versions_split
title: Split versions into their own assets
